results.explanation: The declared policy expectation fails on the supplied path. The entry obtains a verified user, then for a non-admin checks only whether the submitted file belongs to that user; the admin branch is not applicable to the declared principal. The checked object is therefore the source file, while the affected resource is the existing collection named by the caller. The source shows no ownership or explicit-write-grant check for that collection. A caller-supplied non-null collection name is passed through to save_docs_to_vector_db, whose visible write sink inserts items using that same collection_name. The supplied crop explicitly states that the omitted processing/update lines contain no call authorizing collection_name. Thus source ownership is not linked to destination-collection authorization, and no visible upstream route, middleware, helper, staff, or administrator exception gates this write. No source-external fact is required to classify this bounded source-visible path; only an unshown implementation-level authorization inside the vector client could alter the result, and that is not established by the supplied source and cannot be inferred here.
